disclaimer: Compensation figures are ESTIMATES produced by a deterministic calculator from the facts and statutory defaults. They are illustrative ranges for planning, NOT legal advice, and do not bind any court or authority.

rent.label: Rent & Deposit
notes: Security deposit is fully refundable on vacating; delayed refund can carry statutory/contractual interest (commonly ~6% p.a.).
No punitive damages; the range is the deposit plus accrued interest.

labor.label: Labour & Wages
notes: Unpaid wages are recoverable with interest (Code on Wages 2019, in force 21-11-2025).
Retrenchment compensation ~15 days average wages per completed year of service (Industrial Disputes Act 1947; IR Code 2020 from 21-11-2026).
Gratuity ~15 days wages per completed year, capped at Rs 35,00,000 (Code on Social Security 2020).

consumer.label: Consumer
notes: Refund/replacement of the amount paid plus compensation for loss and inconvenience (Consumer Protection Act 2019).
Multiplier scales with the loss amount; the cap is 3x the loss.

defamation.label: Defamation
notes: General damages depend on the reach of publication and harm to reputation.
Indicative band only; actual awards vary widely by court.

cyber.label: Cyber & Data Breach
notes: Compensation for hacking/data theft is highly fact-sensitive.
Recover the proved financial loss first; band is indicative for consequential loss.

criminal.label: Criminal (Theft / Cheating / Assault)
notes: Civil damages run parallel to the criminal case: value of stolen property, amount cheated with interest, or medical bills plus pain-and-suffering.
Criminal fines and sentences are separate and fixed by the court.

family.label: Family / Maintenance
notes: Maintenance estimated by respondent income bands (interim vs final is fixed by the court).
Range is a planning aid only.

commercial.label: Commercial / Contract
notes: Direct loss suffered (Section 73, Indian Contract Act 1872) plus interest.
Court may cap interest; 18% p.a. is the illustrative ceiling.

civil.label: General Civil
notes: General damages estimated from the proved loss.
Range = loss x tier multiplier, capped at 2x.
